usage: Used as the formal name for Hong Kong’s immigration department; it is the office people usually mean when talking about passport, visa, entry, or residence matters.
Commonly appears in news, official notices, and government service contexts. In everyday speech, people may shorten it to 入境處 when speaking casually.
Can be preceded by verbs like 去、搵、聯絡、辦理 to talk about going there or handling a case, e.g. making an appointment or asking about paperwork.
Best used in formal or semi-formal settings; it is not a generic word for any border checkpoint, so don’t use it when you mean a customs or general travel office.

examples.sentence: 我今日要去入境事務處辦理續期手續。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 jap6 ging2 si6 mou6 cyu3 baan6 lei5 ceoi5 kei4 sau2 zuk1.
